56961-the-red-house-on-rowan-street.title: On Rowan Street
56961-the-red-house-on-rowan-street.creator: Roman Doubleday
56961-the-red-house-on-rowan-street.description: A book by Roman Doubleday. When Hugh Burton stepped from the train at High Ridge, he wondered (in his ignorance of the events that were about to engage him) whether he would be able to catch a return train that evening. He had no desire to linger in this half-grown town on the western edge of civilization one minute longer than his fool errand demanded.

arxiv-1903-11627.title: Genetic drift in range expansions is very sensitive to density feedback in dispersal and growth
arxiv-1903-11627.creator: Gabriel Birzu, Sakib Matin, Oskar Hallatschek, Kirill S. Korolev
arxiv-1903-11627.description: Abstract Abstract: Theory predicts rapid genetic drift in expanding populations due to the serial founder effect at the expansion front. Yet, many natural populations maintain high genetic diversity in the newly colonized regions. Here, we investigate whether density-dependent dispersal could provide a resolution of this paradox.

arxiv-2008-06268.title: An Efficient Model Inference Algorithm for Learning-based Testing of Reactive Systems
arxiv-2008-06268.creator: Muddassar A. Sindhu
arxiv-2008-06268.description: Abstract Learning-based testing (LBT) is an emerging methodology to automate iterative black-box requirements testing of software systems. The methodology involves combining model inference with model checking techniques. However, a variety of optimisations on model inference are necessary in order to achieve scalable testing for large systems.

arxiv-2102-03365.title: S-PLUS: LEnticular Galaxies in Stripe 82 S-PLUS: LEnticular Galaxies in Stripe 82 – 5 2021
arxiv-2102-03365.creator: A. Cortesi, K. Saha, F.Ferrari, G. Lucatelli, C. Mendes de Oliveira, S. Dhiwar, C. R. Bom, L. O. Dias
arxiv-2102-03365.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by A. Cortesi, K. Saha, F.Ferrari, G. Lucatelli, C. Mendes de Oliveira, S. Dhiwar, C. R. Bom, L. O. Dias. This work is a Brazilian-Indian collaboration. It aims at investigating the structural properties of Lenticular galaxies in the Stripe 82 using a combination of S-PLUS (Southern Photometric Local Universe Survey) and SDSS data. S-PLUS is a novel optical multi-wavelength survey which will cover nearly 8000 square degrees of the Southern hemisphere in the next years and the first data release covers the Stripe 82 area.

arxiv-2103-07265.title: Pendants to the Euler Beta function
arxiv-2103-07265.creator: Martin Himmel
arxiv-2103-07265.description: Abstract . Motivated by the integral representation of the Euler Beta function, we introduce its Cauchy siblings and investigate some of their properties. Two of these newly introduced functions happen to coincide with some classical means, such as the arithmetic or the logarithmic Cauchy one.

arxiv-2412-06139.title: Bounded Exploration with World Model Uncertainty in Soft Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
arxiv-2412-06139.creator: Ting QIAO, Henry Williams, David Valencia, Bruce MacDonald
arxiv-2412-06139.description: Abstract One of the bottlenecks preventing Deep Reinforcement Learning algorithms (DRL) from real-world applications is how to explore the environment and collect informative transitions efficiently. The present paper describes bounded exploration , a novel exploration method that integrates both ‘soft’ and intrinsic motivation exploration. Bounded exploration notably improved the Soft Actor-Critic algorithm’s performance and its model-based extension’s converging speed.

arxiv-2508-21402.title: SatDINO: A Deep Dive into Self-Supervised Pretraining for Remote Sensing
arxiv-2508-21402.creator: Jakub Straka, Ivan Gruber
arxiv-2508-21402.description: Abstract Self-supervised learning has emerged as a powerful tool for remote sensing, where large amounts of unlabeled data are available. In this work, we investigate the use of DINO, a contrastive self-supervised method, for pretraining on remote sensing imagery. We introduce SatDINO, a model tailored for representation learning in satellite imagery.

pmc-11406755.creator: Debora Leonor Junqueira, Alexandre Biasi Cavalcanti, Juliana Maria Ferraz Sallum, Erika Yasaki, Isabella de Andrade Jesuíno, Alline Stach, Karina Negrelli, Leila de Oliveira Silva, Marcela Almeida Lopes, Adriano Caixeta, Mark YY Chan, Jianhong Ching, Valdemir Malechco Carvalho, Andrea Tedesco Faccio
pmc-11406755.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundCeramides have recently been identified as novel biomarkers associated with diabetes mellitus (DM) and major adverse cardiac and cerebrovascular events (MACCE). This study aims to explore their utility in diagnosing microvascular disease.MethodsThis study prospectively enrolled 309 patients from 2018 to 2020 into three groups: healthy controls (Group 1, N = 51), DM patients without acute myocardial infarction (AMI) (Group 2, N = 150), and DM patients with AMI (Group 3, N = 108).

pmc-12799065.title: A Case of Parvovirus B19 Infection Mimicking Mumps Virus Infection in a Healthy Adult
pmc-12799065.creator: Hiraku Sedogawa, Yoko Suwa, Masakazu Nitta, Yuki Sugito, Yuki Togawa, Daisuke Tomita
pmc-12799065.description: IntroductionHuman parvovirus B19 infection classically manifests as erythema infectiosum in children, but in adults the clinical spectrum is diverse and often atypical. While transient neutropenia and bone marrow suppression have been reported, mumps-like submandibular swelling is rarely described in immunocompetent adults.Case descriptionWe report a 38-year-old previously healthy man who presented with high fever and febrile neutropenia.

pmc-13156812.creator: Fereshteh Kimia, Fatemeh Roodneshin, Mahtab Poorzamany Nejat Kermany, Hamidreza Samadpour, Nima Saeedi, Mina Vishte
pmc-13156812.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and AimsPulmonary aspiration and foreign body in the airway (PAFBA) is one of the medical emergencies, which can mostly affect children and geriatrics. Reporting the epidemiology of this condition is necessary to plan preventive and controlling measures. Our objective was to investigate the burden of PAFBA in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region and its 21 countries from 1990 to 2021, with age and sex patterns.
